scripts.dev: npm run -w shared build && npm run -w frontend dev & npm run -w signaling-server dev
scripts.build: npm run -w shared build && npm run -w signaling-server build && npm run -w frontend build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w shared build && npm run -w shared typecheck && npm run -w signaling-server typecheck && npm run -w frontend typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w shared build && npm run -w shared test && npm run -w signaling-server test && npm run -w frontend test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run -w shared build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run -w shared build && playwright test --headed
scripts.start: npm run -w shared build && npm run -w signaling-server start
scripts.smoke: npm run -w shared build && tsx smoke_frontend.ts
